description: This file defines the SelectedDisplayField entity class which models a database table for selected display fields within reports in the OrangeHRM system. It utilizes Doctrine ORM annotations, includes methods for accessing and modifying its properties, and applies a decorator trait.

classes.name: SelectedDisplayField
classes.description: Entity class representing a selected display field associated with a report, with ORM mappings for database persistence, utilizing a decorator trait.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the SelectedDisplayField instance.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the SelectedDisplayField instance.

methods.name: getDisplayField
methods.description: Returns the DisplayField associated with this selected display field.

methods.name: setDisplayField
methods.description: Associates a DisplayField with this SelectedDisplayField.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Returns the Report associated with this SelectedDisplayField.

methods.name: setReport
methods.description: Associates a Report with this SelectedDisplayField.
